chapters.decision: Modernize ordinary human address and verbs without assigning allegorical identities. Preserve the shift from him to you, breasts, they drew you, uprightness as the subject of loved, black and beautiful, the singular personal vineyard, my mare, turtledoves and kinsman. The feminine self-reference and changes of addressee remain; plural commands address the daughters in 6. Give 3 a sentence stop and put the future running clause of 4 into natural English order. Kinsman is retained provisionally for the lover’s kinship term and does not establish a biological relationship.

chapters.decision: Keep the flower of the plain, plural commands in 4–5 and 15, arranging love without an added banner, wounded by love, the powers/strengths oath, Bethel, the repeated my dove, pruning, and mountains of hollows. I have adjured makes the past oath explicit; adjure means to put someone under a solemn charge. The unspecified closing subject remains it, referring to love without a fixed personal identity. Face in 14 is an idiomatic rendering of the repeated appearance term in this direct visual request. Keep the pastoral verb without supplying an animal object.

chapters.decision: Retain all repetitions of seeking and the unanswered call in 1, the tense shift in held/will not let go in 4, the powers/strengths refrain, sixty warriors and the stone-paved interior with its difficult love clause. Make the ordinary plural question in 3 clear with speech punctuation and use trained for war in 8. Greek plural nights is represented by English at night/in the night as an iterative setting. The publisher’s displayed Rahlfs–Hanhart 3:11 has no daughters of Zion address; retain the existing absence despite the historical study page’s claim about printed editions. That conflict is recorded for apparatus review.

chapters.decision: Ordinary lovers’ address uses you/your. Preserve silence, thalpioth, missiles, the hill/trees/fragrance of Lebanon, beginning of faith, the plural our hearts, breasts, garments, repeated garden enclosed, living water, aloth and all botanical images. Came up in 2 makes the past ascent explicit. Temporal until the day breathes retains ordinary English present form. No veil, mountain Amana, frankincense or modern plant identity is substituted for a difficult Greek reading.

chapters.decision: Keep bread with honey, the brothers invited to drink, sleep and the wakeful heart, the body and door images, the repeated unanswered call, the guards’ violence and the full oath in 8. Modernize human address, make the past adjuration explicit and recast the repeated question in 9 as What makes your kinsman more than another kinsman. Preserve white and ruddy (reddish), myriads, phaz, fir-tree curls, repeated full waters, tharsis, the ivory tablet and throat. No identity for an uncertain stone is supplied.

chapters.decision: Preserve all four Return commands, the Shulammite, daughter of Nadab, rhythms of thighs, the sculpted mixing bowl, daughter of many, the nose and tower image, the king bound in passageways, the palm’s heights, my lips and teeth, his turning and the repeated promise of breasts. Modernize only individually reviewed address and verb forms. You in the question of 1 is plural; the calls to the Shulammite are singular. Greek 7:1 corresponds to common English 6:13, and Greek 7:2–14 to common English 7:1–13; retain this site’s Greek numbering.

chapters.decision: Keep the desired kinship, the chamber of the one who conceived me, the future embrace, and the last oath as a question rather than harmonizing it with earlier commands. Retain made white without adding from the wilderness, both labor clauses, seal/heart/arm, jealousy and Hades, repeated wings of fire, water/rivers, livelihood and the person despised. Gives/will despise in 7 makes the prospective conditional explicit. Keep the little sister, wall/door options, figures of one thousand and two hundred and the final flight. The person addressed in 13 is grammatically masculine in the consulted Greek; no divine addressee is asserted.
